## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 8 окт. 2026 г. - 8 окт. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _swright243_, 8 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "I have been a member for a few years. My first complaint was that Ai had to down grade from black card to basic membership when I was having fiscal difficulties. Staff helped me make the change, but then it automatically reset to black card membership without my approval. I cannot go to the site any longer and looked up how to cancel a subscription at the portal ( was told I could) well- you cannot. So now I’m going down the rabbit hole trying to figure out how to cancel this some other way with no help other than to go in person- which I cannot."
<!--/ir-theme-->
